ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a very low ratio of high-intensity pixels, primarily limited to distal tips and surface water reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity distribution across 95% of the visible surface; high-contrast white pixel clusters are localized contiguously at the extreme distal tips (left and right edges).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of roughly 1:10 relative to fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire boundary; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 15 pixels in amplitude, creating a jagged edge profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature sweeping from the median notch towards the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting a rough, irregular texture.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization and associated scarring at the distal-most points of both the left and right fluke lobes.
